events.reasoning: Evidence shows ssCpuRawIdle rate fell 1197.2/s -> 1.5/s under cpu load, i.e. idle is inverse to load. Previous model expected rise and was rejected. Therefore need a busy-side ssCpuRaw* counter whose rate rises under all-cores-busy user load. Chose ssCpuRawUser (device-wide cumulative over all CPUs). Rejected: ssCpuRawIdle (failed object, falls not rises); ssCpuIdle/ssCpuUser/ssCpuSystem (deprecated in favour of Raw counters); hrProcessorLoad (per-processor column, not device-wide total, requires row aggregation); laLoadInt/laLoadFloat (load average, not CPU time utilisation); ssCpuRawSystem/Wait/Kernel etc (also rise but user time is primary for compute load).

events.reasoning: Evidence says lmTempSensorsValue 1.3.6.1.4.1.2021.13.16.2.1.3 is not served (No Such Object/Instance), so LM-SENSORS-MIB lmTempSensorsTable is not instantiated on this net-snmp agent (typical when libsensors not configured/no sensors). Per instructions must not repeat failed object. Scanned all 210 pollable objects: the only object describing a temperature measurement is that failed object ('The temperature of this sensor in mC'). No other UCD/HOST-RESOURCES object measures temperature. Rejected look-alikes: lmTempSensorsValue - failed live test, do not retry; lmMiscSensorsValue ('The value of this sensor.') - generic misc with no unit, not identified as temperature; lmFanSensorsValue ('The rotation speed of the fan in RPM.') - fan family, not temperature; lmVoltSensorsValue ('The voltage in mV.') - voltage; hrDeviceStatus etc - status, not thermal. Therefore no viable temperature object -> oid null.
